summary: WFN Credit Company, LLC, as depositor for the World Financial Network Credit Card Master Note Trust, filed an 8-K reporting a Seventh Amended and Restated Service Agreement between Comenity Capital Bank (CCB) and Comenity Servicing LLC, plus a First Amendment thereto, effective October 1, 2026. Item 6.02 discloses that upon the merger of Comenity Bank into CCB, with CCB surviving, CCB assumed all servicer rights, duties and obligations. This is a routine servicing/trust administration update for a credit-card ABS shelf, not a special situation; no deal terms, board recommendation, advisor, or transaction economics were stated.
